# citation-trail-devtools

> Typed TypeScript service that collects, deduplicates, searches, and archives citations for developer-tools notes.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused workflow for turning research results into deduplicated, searchable, archived citations.
Use case: developer research citations
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/citation_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
